title: In progress
summary: Work underway and not yet part of the committed game.
bodyHtml:
Everything on this page is in progress and not yet part of the tested, committed game. Details may change; check the repo history and DreamTrack for current state.

  • Relationships, romance and cheating: bonds between members grow into attachments, with notice rolls for whether others catch on. In progress.
  • Witch kidnapping storyline: a multi-scene arc in which a witch takes a party member. In progress.
  • Crew portraits and detail panel: portraits for the party and a panel showing each member's traits and state. In progress.
  • Robotic TTS fallback: browser speech synthesis for spoken lines when no generated audio exists. In progress.
  • Free camera orbit: player-controlled orbit of the 3D view, with the framed shots as the default. In progress.

Also still open from earlier plans (see docs/handoff-video-experiment.md and docs/design.md):

  • The Dream Engine binding: Studio scenes, prefabs and UI. src/main.ts is a placeholder.
  • Live checks of the Hyperlab and fal integrations (see Story and video pipeline).
  • Registering new game files in project.dtproject through the shared project-format transaction API.
